checked.Glide: Playing with the Map on screen, the dot moved along the course between pings, including while no new ping arrived. Not judged: smoothness (the software-GPU emulator and screenrecord caught 5 to 10 frames a second). Seen: the dot sometimes stayed 2 to 3 pings behind the path chip for about 2 s before moving on; the trail still ended at the dot. Opening the replay already playing, the per-frame sampling delayed the Map's first full draw (tiles, trail and dot) by about 2 to 3 s compared with animations off on this emulator; with a 100 ms tick (an experiment, not committed) the trail and dot drew with the first Map frame. Cost: demoRaceRunner took 1.32 ms a call on the phone emulator (91 calls in 2 s, RacePreviewReplayTest, logged under CrewCueGlide), off the main thread, one call in flight at a time.
